## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request contains one coherent outcome.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior and relevant failure cases.
- [ ] Golden or benchmark changes were reviewed semantically.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private corpus, or confidential prompts are present.
- [ ] The author has not approved or merged their own change.
